blind.description: A short, stylized cylindrical masonry pipe or sewer culvert segment resting horizontally on the floor. It features large, smooth grey stone blocks forming circular rims at the ends, surrounding a curved body textured with reddish-brown terracotta or brick-like tiles. The interior is hollow, lined with dark grey masonry/brick with greenish slime and moss staining the lower interior channel, including a small green slime droplet/runoff oozing at the bottom rim. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with hand-painted stylized PBR texturing, standing directly on the floor without any plinth or unattached parts.
blind.from_above: From straight above it appears as a rounded rectangular barrel-like cylinder lying horizontally, flanked by grey stone trim collars on the top and bottom ends and reddish-brown brickwork in between, casting an elongated shadow upwards and to the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 3 to 3.5 feet tall (about half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 feet in diameter/length.
